response.query: What human-factors and implementation-science measures will we embed (usability testing, think-aloud, cognitive workload metrics, structured training and competency checks), how will clinician feedback iterate models/explanations, and which qualitative endpoints will we predefine?
response.answer: We will embed usability testing, think-aloud protocols, and cognitive workload metrics. Clinician feedback will refine models and explanations. Predefined qualitative endpoints will include user satisfaction and task completion rates.
